column1: #   1. the abbreviation as written, in lower case; spaces in it may be left out in the text ("т. е." is "т.е." too);
#   2. its reading with stress marks, or "noun:<nominative>" - a noun of nouns.tsv declined after a preposition
#   3. optional, when it applies: "number" - before a number ("д. 5"); "name" - before a capitalized word or a quote,
#      or after a capitalized word ("г. Москва", "Невский пр."); "before-name" - always, and a name usually follows it
#      ("ул. Ленина"); "address" - after "д." in the same sentence ("д. 7, стр. 2"). The first line that applies wins.
# The dot of an abbreviation before a capitalized word ends the sentence too ("и т. д. Потом"), unless a name follows
